newsitem.title: USA: CMS Energy unit to redeem preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: CMS Energy unit to redeem preferred shares.

text.p: CMS Energy Corp's Consumers Energy Co unit said Friday it will redeem all outstanding shares of its $7.45, $7.68, $7.72 and $7.76 Preferred Stock on September 15.

The $7.45 series will be redeemed at $101.00 per share plus accrued dividends of $1.53139 per share. The $7.68 series will be redeemed at $101.00 per share plus accrued dividends of $1.57867 per share.

The $7.72 series will be redeemed at $101.00 per share plus accrued dividends of $1.58689 per share. The $7.76 series will be redeemed at $102.21 per share plus accrued dividends of $1.59511 per share.

Consumers Energy said shareholders of record are asked to make delivery of their stock certificates as soon as possible to the company's Investor Services Department, in Jackson, Mich. Certificates can also be delivered in person to the Depository Trust Company, Transfer Agent Drop Service in New York City.
